description: Defines valid industry and technique labels for algorithm classification. Auto-index validates algorithm.json tags against this taxonomy.

education.label: Fundamentals & Education
education.description: Core quantum concepts, textbook algorithms, learning exercises

finance.label: Finance & Banking
finance.description: Portfolio optimization, option pricing, risk analysis, credit scoring

chemistry.label: Chemistry & Molecular
chemistry.description: Molecular simulation, ground state energy, reaction pathways

optimization.label: Optimization & Operations Research
optimization.description: Combinatorial optimization, graph problems, constraint satisfaction

cryptography.label: Cryptography & Security
cryptography.description: QKD protocols, quantum random number generation, PQC demonstrations

logistics.label: Logistics & Supply Chain
logistics.description: Vehicle routing, job scheduling, supply chain optimization

pharma.label: Pharma & Healthcare
pharma.description: Drug discovery, molecular docking, protein folding

materials.label: Materials Science
materials.description: Band structure, lattice models, condensed matter simulation

ml.label: Quantum Machine Learning
ml.description: Quantum kernels, classifiers, generative models, feature maps

energy.label: Energy & Sustainability
energy.description: Grid optimization, battery simulation, carbon capture modeling

telecom.label: Telecommunications
telecom.description: Network optimization, channel coding, resource allocation

gate.label: Gate-Based Circuit
gate.description: Standard quantum circuit with discrete gates

vqa.label: Variational (VQA)
vqa.description: Variational quantum algorithms — parameterized circuits + classical optimizer

annealing.label: Quantum Annealing
annealing.description: QUBO/Ising optimization via quantum or simulated annealing

qec.label: Quantum Error Correction
qec.description: Error correcting codes, syndrome decoding, fault tolerance

classical.label: Classical Baseline
classical.description: Classical solvers for comparison (exact diag, brute-force)
